shortDescription: Sanlam Ltd. profit fell 22% as weather-related claims in South Africa increased and a stronger rand reduced the translated value of earnings from businesses outside its home market, according to Bloomberg.

title: Sanlam Profit Drops 22% on Higher Claims and India Weakness
